set.body: Attack only baseline-owned losses in Grakern: preparation builders, exact interning, feature dictionaries, integer-coded sparse rows, merge dots, shared transformations, postings versus sparse or dense Gram strategies, tiling, worker reuse, and allocation. Every change retains the independent denotation, deterministic numerical policy, differential tests, and before-after receipts.
set.title: Eliminate measured Grakern engine losses
